claim: POST /orders/bulk-cancel must return 400 when the order_ids list is empty.
Only the user who created an order may cancel it; bulk cancel must not cancel orders belonging to other users.
Stock is restored only for orders that were actually cancelled by the bulk-cancel request, not for skipped orders.
Orders that are not in placed status are silently skipped during bulk cancel and appear in the skipped list.
POST /orders/bulk-cancel cancels each eligible placed order and restores the stock of each cancelled order's items.
